portfolio.title: Roman Bastrykin — frontend developer

readme.about: Three years of commercial development at E-Publish, a company that builds websites for schools and kindergartens. The company's main product is <site>School Website</site>, used by 4,000+ organizations: I took part in supporting and developing it — new features, bug fixes, performance.
readme.focus: I also took part in building and launching a new product, School Libraries, starting from the MVP. It was frontend-heavy, and I was actively involved in both development and interface design.
readme.now: Currently building Planck — a kanban tracker with shared boards, realtime updates and drag-and-drop on every level. It lives right on this site.
readme.open: Looking for a frontend role — remote or in Belgrade.

epublish.about: EdTech platform for school and kindergarten websites
points: Took part in supporting and developing the School Website platform for 4,000–5,000 schools and kindergartens.
Cut LCP on an image-heavy page from 4–5 s to ~1 s with lazy loading and targeted optimization.
Took part in building and launching the new School Libraries product: frontend architecture, interfaces, design. Presented the MVP to librarians — the first audience became the first clients.
Replaced CKEditor with a GrapesJS-based visual page editor with reusable blocks, so non-technical users can build pages.
Fixed a Docker / GitLab CI build that had been broken on fresh setups for ~6 months — in 2 days, with docs.

projects.title: Projects
projects.planck: Kanban tracker: boards → columns → tasks → subtasks. Shared boards with members and realtime updates.
planck-facts: Drag-and-drop on every level with weighted ordering — minimal DB writes
Passkey (WebAuthn) or password sign-in, JWT in an httpOnly cookie
Realtime over Server-Sent Events with animated remote changes
FSD architecture, Vitest tests, CI/CD on GitHub Actions
projects.think-twice: Marketing site for an AI startup: turned Figma designs into responsive components with Next.js Server Components and Tailwind.
projects.serbiatrip: Landing page for guided tours of Serbia: hero, tour program, benefits and a booking form.
projects.news-from-telegram: News feed from a Telegram channel: a bot pulls the posts and the page renders them as cards with an image, title and text.
projects.f1-tracker: Electron desktop app: the next Grand Prix with its track map, drivers and a Scuderia Ferrari fact sheet. A university OOP project.
